SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.quantity) units, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product cp0 ON cp0.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=cp0.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT count(*) lines, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, count(distinct sales_line_id) dist_id, sum(quantity) units, min(quantity) minq, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) staff_units, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code<>'ST' THEN quantity END) nonst,
 (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM l)) returned_units
FROM l
